policy.purpose: Permanent replayable R5 regression ownership without patient dialogue or runtime secrets.
policy.fixedRule: Fixed requires a confirmed root cause, full fix SHA, and an existing permanent regression.
policy.humanBugRule: A human bug remains open until symptom, exact root cause, replay, fix SHA, evidence, and permanent gate are recorded.
policy.privacyRule: Never store patient dialogue, prompts, reasoning, bearer values, state-token values, usernames, or complete user paths.
policy.frozenBoundary: Never change data/**, medical facts, review states, scoring contracts, or frozen R4.1/R5 artifacts for test convenience.

entries.title: Stage 3 sparse-evidence dead end
entries.userVisibleSymptom: Stage 2 can be submitted with too little usable evidence, after which stage 3 cannot be completed and the learner cannot return to collect evidence.

rootCause.detail: Submission locking and stage-3 eligibility were validated independently, allowing a locked state with neither sufficient evidence nor a recovery action.

minimumReproduction.environment: Deterministic seven-stage runner with sparse evidence
steps: Initialize P001 in free mode.
Submit stages 1 and 2 below the stage-3 evidence requirement.
Verify a legal recovery action remains available.

entries.legacyGap: The 42-case flow used empty fixed submissions and proved endpoint order, not evidence sufficiency or recoverability.

entries.title: Random mode was sent to the durable-attempt API
entries.userVisibleSymptom: Random training opened, but durable initialization returned HTTP 400 and later saves were not durable.

rootCause.detail: The renderer sent UI mode random to an endpoint accepting only free, osce, or rct, and initialization recovered from 404 but not that 400.

minimumReproduction.environment: Mode-contract test
steps: Create random attempt identity.
Resolve its durable mode.
Assert the request uses free while UI identity remains random.

entries.legacyGap: Renderer E2E used an in-memory bridge while sidecar acceptance bypassed the renderer, so incompatible mode vocabularies both passed.

entries.title: Renderer autosave did not reach durable state
entries.userVisibleSymptom: The window appeared usable, but closing and reopening lost recent questions and stage progress.

rootCause.detail: Durable initialization failed before a server row existed while the renderer continued with volatile state and tests observed only mocked save calls.

minimumReproduction.environment: Real renderer, sidecar, and temporary SQLite
steps: Initialize a fresh attempt.
Change state and wait for save acknowledgement.
Recreate the renderer and load from SQLite.

entries.legacyGap: The browser bridge persisted to a Map and desktop acceptance used direct HTTP without the real client save lifecycle.

entries.title: Packaged backend passed while the Tauri window failed
entries.userVisibleSymptom: Direct backend diagnostics passed, but the real window could not initialize or persist an attempt.

rootCause.detail: Automation launched the sidecar directly and never exercised Tauri resources, runtime injection, WebView2, renderer, SQLite, and normal close as one chain.

minimumReproduction.environment: Tauri no-bundle executable with test-only WebView2 CDP
steps: Launch real Tauri with an isolated profile.
Save through the visible renderer.
Close normally, restart, restore, and verify cleanup.

entries.legacyGap: Source renderer and packaged-sidecar tests covered disjoint halves of the product.

entries.title: New stage inherited the previous scroll position
entries.userVisibleSymptom: After advancing, the learner landed partway down the new stage and could miss its title and instructions.

rootCause.detail: The persistent scroll container was reused without resetting its position when active stage changed.

minimumReproduction.environment: 390 by 844 and 1093 by 614 viewports
steps: Scroll to the bottom of a long stage.
Advance.
Assert the responsible container starts at the top.

entries.legacyGap: Screenshots inspected settled layouts but did not execute scroll-then-transition.

entries.title: Fixed action area obscured content
entries.userVisibleSymptom: At short desktop or mobile heights, the action area covered inputs or the last content row.

rootCause.detail: Sticky positioning and bottom spacing were checked separately, allowing action and content regions to overlap.

minimumReproduction.environment: Short desktop and mobile viewports with long bilingual text
steps: Open a long form.
Scroll every focusable control into view.
Assert no rectangle intersects the sticky action region.

entries.legacyGap: Static geometry checks did not compare every focusable control after scrolling.

entries.title: Language switching lost keyboard focus
entries.userVisibleSymptom: Switching Chinese and English moved focus, forcing keyboard users to restart navigation or type into the wrong control.

rootCause.detail: Language rerender replaced or reordered the focused subtree without a focus-restoration contract.

minimumReproduction.environment: Desktop and mobile renderer with keyboard input
steps: Focus the primary input.
Switch language by keyboard.
Assert focus remains on the equivalent control and accepts one input.

entries.legacyGap: Language tests asserted text, not activeElement and post-switch typing.

entries.title: R4 and R5 installation or data identity can collide
entries.userVisibleSymptom: Installing, running, or uninstalling R5 can overwrite or remove R4 state or installation metadata.

rootCause.detail: R5 has a separate data subdirectory, but frozen R4 and current R5 retain the same NSIS product name, version, identifier, and install mode.

minimumReproduction.environment: Disposable Windows VM with frozen R4 installed
steps: Create R4 durable state.
Install and run R5.
Uninstall each product independently and verify the other state remains.

entries.legacyGap: Data-directory names were validated without side-by-side Windows installation identity.

entries.title: Unicode, spaces, and long paths were not portable
entries.userVisibleSymptom: Preparation or startup succeeds on the developer computer but fails under a Chinese, spaced, or deeply nested path.

rootCause.detail: Earlier readiness relied on an ASCII repository path and host tooling, leaving path-safe argument passing and bundled-resource discovery unexercised.

minimumReproduction.environment: Scratch package copy under a Chinese spaced near-long path
steps: Copy without renaming frozen artifacts.
Launch as a standard user without host Node.
Save, close, reopen, and export diagnostics.

entries.legacyGap: Local tests reused the repository path and installed development runtime.

entries.title: Required packaged runtime resource is missing
entries.userVisibleSymptom: The backend cannot start and the app must show an actionable safe diagnostic instead of a blank or hanging window.

rootCause.detail: The injected cause is removal of one required resource from a scratch package copy.

minimumReproduction.environment: Scratch staged-resource copy
steps: Remove one required resource.
Launch.
Assert fail-closed classification, no secret leakage, and no process residue.

entries.legacyGap: Bundle scans prove presence in one artifact but not visible recovery after loss or quarantine.

entries.title: Local model is missing or fails its hash contract
entries.userVisibleSymptom: Preparation fails or silently runs a different model when the expected model is absent, partial, or corrupt.

rootCause.detail: The scenarios inject an absent model and a mismatched digest in an isolated R5 data directory.

minimumReproduction.environment: Isolated R5 model directory
steps: Run without a model.
Run with a wrong-digest same-name file.
Assert safe fallback or actionable failure, correct label, and zero cloud requests.

entries.legacyGap: Optional real-model tests did not exercise corrupt or absent model recovery through the visible app.

entries.title: SQLite is locked or corrupt
entries.userVisibleSymptom: Preparation or save fails; the app must not delete the database, report success, or strand processes.

rootCause.detail: Tests use a real exclusive SQLite lock and a corrupt scratch database rather than fabricated error text.

minimumReproduction.environment: Temporary R5 SQLite database
steps: Hold an exclusive lock and attempt save.
Repeat with a corrupt copy.
Verify classification, no deletion, and recovery after lock release.

entries.legacyGap: Compatibility tests supplied synthetic labels instead of provoking real SQLite errors.

entries.title: Repeated preparation can race or duplicate runtime work
entries.userVisibleSymptom: Rapid repeated prepare actions can leave duplicate progress, an unresponsive action, or orphaned processes.

rootCause.detail: No production trace identifies whether renderer, Tauri command, sidecar startup, or model installer owns the suspected race.

minimumReproduction.environment: Real Tauri with deterministic delayed preparation
steps: Trigger prepare ten times rapidly.
Wait for one terminal result.
Assert one runtime, one state transition, and no residue.

entries.legacyGap: Lifecycle tests invoke prepare once and wait before another action.

entries.title: A second case can inherit first-case state
entries.userVisibleSymptom: Another case can show the previous case language, answers, stage, evidence, or report.

rootCause.detail: Attempt identity includes case, language, and mode, but browser state and SQLite isolation were never asserted together across a case switch.

minimumReproduction.environment: Real renderer, sidecar, and SQLite
steps: Save P001 Chinese free progress.
Save P003 English random progress.
Return to P001 and assert each attempt has only its own state.

entries.legacyGap: Pure identity and direct-sidecar tests omitted renderer caches and SQLite authority together.

entries.title: Normal close and reopen does not restore authority
entries.userVisibleSymptom: Progress appears saved until the desktop process closes, then disappears or duplicates after reopening.

rootCause.detail: Browser reload and direct sidecar restart substituted for the real Tauri close handler, process cleanup, WebView profile, and SQLite reopen.

minimumReproduction.environment: Tauri no-bundle with persistent isolated R5 directories
steps: Save visible state.
Close normally and wait for the process tree.
Restart and verify one restored attempt and revision.

entries.legacyGap: No permanent test sends normal close to a real Tauri window and reconnects after full exit.

entries.title: Student output exposes internal fields
entries.userVisibleSymptom: A learner can see teacher-only diagnosis, scoring, provenance, intent, agent, review, or workflow fields in API, DOM, clipboard, or export.

rootCause.detail: This permanent privacy invariant applies explicit allowlists at server projection and every student output channel.

minimumReproduction.environment: Student session across all output channels
steps: Complete representative stages.
Capture student-authorized output.
Assert the allowlist and absence of internal field families.

entries.legacyGap: Existing checks cover selected responses or static output, not every channel after a full desktop journey.

entries.title: Stage 7 exposes internal 360-point score
entries.userVisibleSymptom: The learner can see the internal raw score or its private component breakdown.

rootCause.detail: The server-authoritative score must be projected to the approved student scale before every student-facing output.

minimumReproduction.environment: Completed stage-7 student attempt
steps: Complete seven stages.
Inspect API, DOM, clipboard, and export.
Assert approved projection and absence of internal raw fields.

entries.legacyGap: Projection tests did not prove every stage-7 desktop channel uses the projection.

entries.title: Desktop training sends a cloud request
entries.userVisibleSymptom: A desktop action contacts a non-loopback service, violating the offline and privacy promise.

rootCause.detail: Zero cloud requests is a permanent runtime invariant at sidecar authority and test-process network boundaries.

minimumReproduction.environment: Canonical Tauri journey with loopback instrumentation
steps: Perform representative actions.
Exercise safe fallback.
Assert cloud count is zero and no non-loopback connection occurred.

entries.legacyGap: Direct backend counters omitted requests initiated by the packaged WebView.

entries.title: Rule fallback is labeled local AI
entries.userVisibleSymptom: When the model is unavailable, the UI claims local AI produced a rule-fallback response.

rootCause.detail: Serving-mode labels must derive from runtime evidence, not requested mode or HTTP success.

minimumReproduction.environment: Real renderer with deterministic model-start failure
steps: Force safe model failure.
Perform a supported action.
Assert fact-bound output and safe-fallback label, never local AI.

entries.legacyGap: Backend fallback and visible labels were tested separately.

entries.title: Child processes or ports remain after close
entries.userVisibleSymptom: After closing, sidecar or model processes retain memory or ports and can break the next launch.

rootCause.detail: Zero residual process and port state is checked after normal close and repeated cycles.

minimumReproduction.environment: Real Tauri with sidecar and deterministic model
steps: Launch and close normally ten times.
Inspect child PIDs and ports after each exit.
Assert all are gone before next launch.

entries.legacyGap: Direct lifecycle tests do not prove real window close releases the Job Object and CDP port.

entries.title: Old WebView cache conflicts with fresh SQLite
entries.userVisibleSymptom: A fresh data store opens with old stage state or initialization fails because cached identity disagrees with SQLite.

rootCause.detail: WebView storage and SQLite were tested independently; no test retained the old profile while replacing the authoritative database.

minimumReproduction.environment: Persistent WebView profile with replaceable temporary SQLite
steps: Cache a durable attempt.
Replace only SQLite with a fresh store.
Restart and assert bootstrap clears incompatible cache and creates coherent authority.

entries.legacyGap: State-authority tests used MemoryStorage instead of real WebView profile plus replaced database.

entries.title: Product HEAD authority degrades to desktop-local
entries.userVisibleSymptom: Diagnostics, sidecar, SQLite, and artifact evidence claim different builds, making saved state and evidence untrustworthy.

rootCause.detail: Tauri passes HEMATURIA_PRODUCT_HEAD while SQLite reads NEXT_PUBLIC_GIT_SHA and the sidecar previously defaulted missing values to desktop-local.

minimumReproduction.environment: Staged sidecar and Tauri diagnostic built from a full SHA
steps: Launch with Tauri product-head authority.
Read safe diagnostic and SQLite authority.
Assert both equal artifact HEAD and never desktop-local.

entries.legacyGap: Tests supplied NEXT_PUBLIC_GIT_SHA directly and accepted desktop-local.

entries.title: Installer and runtime use different model directories
entries.userVisibleSymptom: The installer reports success, but the app still reports the model missing.

rootCause.detail: R5 runtime resolves MentorLocalAI-R5 while installer, acceptance, benchmark, or docs retained an older identifier rather than one resolver.

minimumReproduction.environment: Path contract test without model download
steps: Resolve install, runtime, acceptance, and benchmark targets.
Normalize paths.
Assert one R5 models directory.

entries.legacyGap: Each script built its own default path and no shared test compared them.

entries.title: R5 NSIS identity is not isolated from R4
entries.userVisibleSymptom: Windows can treat R5 as an R4 update or let one uninstaller remove the other product.

rootCause.detail: Frozen R4 and current R5 share productName, version, identifier, and current-user install mode.

minimumReproduction.environment: Candidate preflight plus disposable Windows VM
steps: Compare frozen R4 and candidate identity fields before build.
Stop if all are equal.
After isolation, install and uninstall both independently in a VM.

entries.legacyGap: Data-directory isolation was used as a proxy for Windows installer identity.

entries.title: Original mentor computer could not prepare and save reliably
entries.userVisibleSymptom: On the original mentor computer, preparation or state saving failed although the developer computer passed.

rootCause.detail: The original trace and equivalent replay are unavailable; mode normalization, security policy, permissions, resources, and SQLite remain distinct hypotheses.

minimumReproduction.environment: Original mentor machine or evidence-equivalent clean Windows with default security
steps: Run diagnostics without developer tools.
Prepare, save, close, and reopen once.
Export only sanitized diagnostics and cleanup facts.

entries.legacyGap: Local success and a different extraction path cannot establish the original-machine root cause.
